title: Mall world hack
content: So, I’ve found that if there’s an area of Mall World that I have trouble gaining access to or something has changed that I want to revert back, if I insist during my waking life that it is so, it’ll become that way when I go back. For instance, the lifeguards in pool world kept kicking me out of the slides area bc I didn’t have a wrist band, so I kept telling myself in my waking life that I don’t need one bc I own the entire park and can go wherever/change whatever I want. I got a tiny bit of push back at first, but I just said something to whichever character that was being bothersome like “Nooo, I own the place now, remember?” And they backed down. So, give yourself keys to every room, an infinite bank card or make yourself ruler of the world and have at it!! It has never failed me ☺️
